notes.text: Each chord gets half a bar of eighth notes: a downstroke held over the next clock, then down, up. With **Strum dir** on Alt the hand turns on every clock, held or not, so the downstrokes stay on the beat and the upstrokes on the offbeats.

**Strum** 25 ms rolls each chord from the bass string up on a downstroke, and from the top string down on an upstroke. **Taper** 40% softens the strings struck last, so an upstroke only brushes the bass.

The porch counts the same eighths as the hand: a pad under every stroke. A heel comes down on 1 and 3. The shaker plays two grains a stroke, a ×2 ratchet, soft under a downstroke and a little harder under an upstroke, so it leans against the strum.
